content: Audit trail vs observability distinction: observability = performance/health monitoring; auditability = accountability/traceability/governance for compliance. Audit trail = durable, tamper-evident record of every agent decision, the inputs held at that moment, and the policy/reasoning that produced the chosen action. Must log: execution context, tool calls, policy checks, approvals, outputs, exceptions, user-impacting actions. Must monitor: abnormal behavior, repeated failure loops, risky tool use, high-impact actions, override frequency, drift/role deviation.
